verdict.rationale: Elastic documents a wide range of official client libraries covering popular programming languages (elastic-docs-6), giving AI-native developers standard SDKs to build against, complementing official MCP server support for agentic integration (elastic-docs-28, elastic-probe-4). missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of SDK quality/coverage beyond first-party docs, and no explicit mention of language-specific AI/agent framework integrations within the SDKs themselves.
